title: Friends 0
text: “Even I didn’t expect things to turn out like this. It’s true, though, that I wanted him to get his just deserts.”

I never imagined it was a poison that would cause such a quick and painful death—I thought it was the kind that would make him suffer for a long time before he died. Well, perhaps I should have used a smaller dose.
“Is that so…? I’m sorry for the misunderstanding.”
“It’s all right.”
“In any case, my sense of justice is tingling. That person was a truly terrible villain—it’s simply that the villain brought about their own downfall!”
Fleon-chan said cheerfully to the immortal.
“She was supposed to be a princess…”
“No, it seems she’s already been stripped of her royal rights, so she’s a former member of the royal family.”
“Still…”
The old man is watching the queen’s back. She’s putting on a brave face, but it’s not as if you can’t see a certain air of melancholy about her.
“What a fool he was. Still… well, serves him right, I suppose.”
My father is laughing at Crimson Swine’s demise. I’ll join in the laughter too.
“That Motoyasu guy—I’m sure he was suspicious, but he’s laughing. There’s something off about him, too.”
“It really seems like all you heroes are a bit off, doesn’t it…”
With that, Father and Big Sister both tilted their heads in puzzlement. Anyway, I’ve accomplished my goal!
“Buh…”

All that’s left is the Lazy Pig… but well, he probably won’t do anything particularly problematic. With his crisis-avoidance skills, he knows full well that if he does anything unnecessary, he’ll get killed.
“Well then… things have turned into quite a mess. I’m afraid it would be difficult for us to host a dinner under these circumstances.”
“I’d say so…”
My father turns to me, Ren, and Itsuki.
“Thanks to Motoyasu, we managed to pull through, but I’m sure you don’t want to eat and drink in a place like this. How about we just eat in the garden?”
“We do need to eat… but you’re right—this isn’t exactly a time for celebration. Another problem could pop up at any moment.”
“Hmph… Darkness has returned to darkness.”
“That’s right.”

Itsuki agrees, and Ren, munching on a Black Thunder bar, nods along with this baffling conclusion. By the way, Ren’s companions are watching from a distance away from him. The sense of distance is even greater now.
“Dinner…”
Filo-tan is disappointed that the thing she was looking forward to isn’t here! Eek… a lonely Filo-tan is terrifying.
“It’s a waste of the meal we prepared! So wouldn’t it be better to eat somewhere else?”
“I’m not really in the mood to eat… but, well, you’re right. Then let’s just take the food out to the garden and eat it at our leisure.”
My Father nodded, meeting Filo-tan’s gaze.
“…Understood. Well, it’ll be a smaller gathering than originally planned, but please enjoy your meal, Heroes.”
My suggestion was accepted, and we ended up having a standing reception in the garden. Although the atmosphere was somewhat subdued, my Father and the others seemed to be enjoying their meal.
“Yay!”
Filo-tan seems satisfied as well.
“Oh, it’s Spear Guy.”
Eek! Filo-tan is coming toward me. Is she going to kick me!?
“Hmm?”
“Filo-tan, how are you today?”
“I’m sooo happy!”
I handed her the chocolate I’d had made into a spear for Fleon-chan and Black Thunder.
“S-shall I have some?”
“Are you giving it to Filo again?”
“Of course I am.”
“Yay! Thanks!”
Filo-tan took the chocolate from me and, while eating it, headed over to the plate of food. Phew… That’s a relief.
“This is delicious!”
“It’s true—the food at the castle tastes great.”
“Mmm…”
Fleon-chan and Itsuki are enjoying their meal together with the stalker pig.
“Motoyasu-san, this tastes really good.”
“I’m glad you’re satisfied. You should eat as much as Filo-tan does.”
“Yes. By the way, I spoke with someone named Filo-san a little while ago, and she said that the food prepared by her ‘husband’ tastes even better than the castle’s cuisine.”
“That’s true—Father’s cooking really is exquisite. I can confidently say that even Fleon-chan would find it to her liking.”
“What! I’d definitely love to try that!　Could you please arrange that for me?”
“Hmm, let’s see…”

My father, whom I’ve wrongly accused, tends to get a bit prickly these days. I think he’d cook for me if I asked, but first I’ll have to earn his favor in various ways. Since I’m cooperating with him on this matter, I don’t think he’d say no. By the way, Ren is eating while leaning against a nearby tree, casting a watchful glance around as if keeping an eye on his surroundings.
“Food! Food! Ahaha!”
On the other hand, Black Thunder is eating heartily alongside Filo-tan. The plates, piled high with food, are rapidly emptying.
“Well then, to liven things up a bit, I’ll sing a song!”
Fleon-chan, who loves having fun, starts singing.
“Dyuwa dyuwa~ fufufun”
It’s what you’d call a cappella. I can hear a nice rhythm coming through.
“Ooh—evil runs rampant behind the scenes of the world~”
And with that, Fleon-chan began singing the lyrics.
“Ah… aaaah…”
Staggering slightly, Itsuki picked up a leaf that had fallen from a tree, held it to his lips, and began playing a grass whistle. Before long, he was skillfully providing the accompaniment.
“Bueee…”

I’m ignoring that pathetic sound from the stalker pig. I don’t have the time to deal with a stalker right now. Hmm? I seem to recall my kind Father, Ren, and Itsuki mentioning something about “pure love” or something like that. Well, whatever.
“It’s a pointlessly rhythmic song—or rather, it has a Super Sentai vibe to it.”
My Father offered his assessment of the song Fleon was singing.
“Though… there’s a suspicion it’s a brainwashing sound wave… is it only affecting Itsuki? I’d hate it if there were subliminal effects or something…”
“This Black Thunder-sama is going to sing, too!”

Now Black Thunder has started singing as well. He can actually produce a surprisingly high-pitched voice. Come to think of it, since Black Thunder is also Kuro-chan, I suppose he can make a voice like this.
“Huh… the forces of darkness have arrived.”
Ren started striking a pose in front of Black Thunder as he sang.
“Those guys are something else… I mean, those two Filolials over there are each making a racket and shrieking. It’s starting to make Filo look cute.”
“Hmm? Master, is Filo going to sing a song, too?”
“You don’t have to sing.”
That’s the kind of way the Filolial-sama are each livening up the atmosphere. I found myself feeling nostalgic watching that scene. After all, I used to work as an idol in Shieldfreeden.
Come to think of it, we did all sorts of things in that loop. We achieved great success with the Filolial-sama group. …Ah, that’s all thanks to Yuki-chan’s hard work.

Speaking of which, Yuki-chan in this cycle… well. It might be a good idea to recruit Yuki-chan next time. By this time of year, Yuki-chan has already been shipped out from the breeder and is at a different farm for competition birds.
“Well then… Heroes, there’s been a lot going on, but I hope you enjoyed your meal.”
Just as everyone had finished eating, the Queen—who had been mourning the death of the Crimson Swine—was talking with the Immortal to take her mind off things, and she said:
“I’d like to express my gratitude here to Lord Iwatani, the key figure in this commotion, as well as to all of you, the Heroes. We would like to compensate you for your efforts.”

Ah, so they’re doing it here after all. By the way, our reputation as heroes—excluding Father—has taken a hit within Melromarc. Now that we’re back from the island, we’re being subtly urged to venture out and face the challenges beyond our borders. Well, we all nodded in agreement that it was a good time to head to other hunting grounds, so we each set off to challenge the Spirit Tortoise to obtain what we needed.
“It seems that… Cal Mira Island, located in the waters near this country, will soon become active. We ask that you, the Heroes, please participate enthusiastically.”
My Father tilts his head slightly, as if this information is new to him.
“Ah… that island, you mean? It might indeed be a good way to build up our strength for what lies ahead. Fleon, Rishia.”
“That’s right!”
“Bub…”
It seems Itsuki is up for it.
“I sense trouble brewing.”
“S-Sword Hero?”
Rin’s companions are timidly addressing him.
“It’s good for you guys to go and build up your dark power, too. I couldn’t take you with me in the last battle because you didn’t have enough dark power.”
“Y-yes! We’ll do our best!”
“That’s right. You’ll have to take a test to see if you’re fit to join the Dark Brave Squad!”
Ren’s companions look anxious at Black Thunder’s words. Their expressions seem to say, “What on earth is going on here?”
“What’s going on? What’s happening?”
“Since Lord Iwatani doesn’t seem to know, let me explain. ‘Activation’ is a phenomenon that occurs once every ten years, during which the amount of EXP obtainable in that region increases.”
Then the Queen is kindly and politely explaining everything about Cal Mira Island to her Father.
“Preparations have been underway for quite some time, and regarding our participation in this Cal Mira Island event, I’d like to ask the Heroes to take part in one major event.”
“An event?”
It’s a party swap, isn’t it? Just as I’m about to say that, the Queen is staring intently at me for some reason.

“The idea is to facilitate information exchange among the heroes and to try rotating personnel for half the time they’re stationed on Cal Mira Island. Of course, this would be done with the consent of all four parties…”

“Ah… Motoyasu does seem a bit isolated on his own. That guy Fleon seems more like Itsuki’s companion than yours, and Black Thunder’s the same. I see—so that’s why it felt off without those women around.”
That’s certainly true. Fleon and Black Thunder are actually under my main registration as Filolial-sama, but they’re currently on loan to Ren and Itsuki.

“But—… well, I was planning to hold an event, but, Spear Hero, given that the ‘Bitch’ and her friend ended up like this, and Miss Elena has withdrawn due to the shock and says she’s returning to her parents’ home…”
“Well, knowing you, you’d probably just bring some girl you picked up on the street or something.”
“Naofumi-sama… I think that’s a bit too sarcastic, even for you… I know it’s his own fault, but someone died, you know?”
You’re so kind, Big Sister. You’re really looking out for me. But there’s no need to go that far.
“It’s fine. We’ll replenish our ranks later!”

This is the perfect opportunity to bring back Yuki-chan and the others, as I’ve been thinking about doing for a while. Ku, Marine, and Midori would be fine, too. However, these three don’t have the same energy they did in the first world. I wonder why.

Also, let’s ask Fleon-chan and Black Thunder to order Ren and Itsuki not to unseal the Spirit Tortoise after we’re done with Cal Mira Island. If we tell them that’s the path of evil, they’ll surely listen, and we can just give them some better information in return.
“But I have some business to attend to. I’ll be a little late. I’ll definitely catch up with you later, so I’d like everyone to go ahead without me.”
“Business, huh…”
“Spear Hero, what are you planning to do? May I ask?”
The Queen seems to want to know where I’m headed.
“There are various things, but I’m gathering companions.”
“I see… That’s necessary, isn’t it? Understood. Then, please make sure to meet up with us on Cal Mira Island.”
And so, our plan for the future was decided.
It was that night. It happened just as everyone had finished dinner and begun resting in their rooms. I knocked on my Father’s door to get his attention.
“What is it? Oh, Motoyasu, it’s you… What do you want?”
“I’ve come to tell you everything I’ve been hiding.”
“…I see. So, is it okay to talk about this here?”
“Hmm? The Spear Guy?”
Eek… Filo-tan is here. I’m still shaking, you know.
“Well, if possible, I’d like to talk with you alone. Or…”
I glanced over at Big Sister doing push-ups next to Filo-tan.
“Three of us would be fine, too.”
“Excluding Filo, you mean…? Do you really hate getting kicked in the groin that much?”
No, getting kicked in the groin by Filo-tan wasn’t really a big deal. It’s just that remembering that Filo-tan from the loop scares me!
“Boo… Are you leaving Filo out of the group?”
“Eeeeeek…”
“…Sigh. Motoyasu’s scared… and then there’s that whole Zeltoble thing from the other day. “Filo, weren’t you supposed to sleep at Melty’s place?”
“Ah! That’s right! Well then, Master, I’ll be off!”
Filo-tan scurries past me. She walks down the castle hallway, heading toward her Finacée.
